intelill_transfer_of_learning.definition: The ability to use what you learned in one situation in a different situation.
intelill_transfer_of_learning.example: The training transferred well: the same method worked on a new line.

peel.definition: The outside skin of a fruit. You usually peel it before eating.
peel.example: I peel the orange before I eat it.

signal_to_noise.definition: The proportion of useful information (signal) to everything else (noise) in a stream of content.
